progression_tree.description: Soldier Heavy Weapons specialists are masters of devastating firepower and area control, using heavy blasters, rocket launchers, and other heavy weapons to dominate the battlefield and suppress enemy positions.
You have advantage on attack rolls with heavy weapons, and you can use your bonus action to brace a heavy weapon, reducing its recoil and granting you advantage on your next attack with it.

effects.notes: Advantage on heavy weapon attack rolls
Brace heavy weapon for advantage on next attack

progression_tree.description: You can use your action to lay down suppressive fire in a 30-foot cone. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d8 blaster damage and be unable to take reactions until the end of their next turn.

effects.notes: Deal 2d8 blaster damage and prevent reactions

progression_tree.description: You can use your action to throw a grenade or fire an explosive weapon at a point within 60 feet. Each creature in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on that point must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 4d6 blaster damage.

When you hit with a heavy weapon attack, you can use your bonus action to make an additional attack with the same weapon. Additionally, you have advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone or moved against your will.

effects.notes: Make additional heavy weapon attack as bonus action
Advantage on saves against being knocked prone or moved

progression_tree.description: You can use your action to enter a state of perfect gunnery focus. For 1 minute, you have advantage on all attack rolls with heavy weapons, and your heavy weapon attacks deal additional damage equal to your Strength modifier. You can use this feature once per long rest.

effects.notes: Advantage on all heavy weapon attack rolls
Add Strength modifier to heavy weapon damage

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assume a defensive stance with lightsaber at the ready, reflecting the intensity of the surrounding battlefield.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A radiant aura of blue and orange energy pulses from your being, reacting to the raw power of the Force.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A lone Jedi Knight stands atop a windswept cliff overlooking a distant galaxy, illuminated by twin suns setting behind their silhouette.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Heavily armed and armored warriors who lay down suppressive fire to keep enemies at bay.
